GRIDIRON LEGEND!

Brady beat all seven Head Coaches and became Champion of the Gridiron Isles!
Keep exploring to find every legendary chest, fill your Dino-Dex, and clear your Film Room.

Learn football by out-coaching dinosaurs! Every answer comes with a short explanation, so new fans learn the game while longtime fans test what they know.

🗺️Explore the isles
  • A huge world of plains, coast, forest, mountains, ruins, springs and desert, with a lava-ringed volcano at the center
  • 7 football towns, each with its own Head Coach, shop and fountain
  • 56 townspeople who share football tips, run pop quizzes for coins, or hand out gifts
  • 55 treasure chests, including 5 gold chests guarded by legendary coaches
  • A secret island that only opens for the very best players
🧠Learn football by playing
  • 353 NFL questions across Teams & Cities, Players, Rules, Stadiums, Positions & Strategy, and History
  • An explanation after every answer, right or wrong
  • Picture questions: read 15 official referee signals and spot 10 offensive and defensive formations
  • A built-in Guide to study every signal and formation
  • A Film Room that brings back missed questions until you've got them down
🏆Coaches, legends and bosses
  • 6 Head Coach dinos, each an expert in one category
  • Commissioner Spino, the final boss, asks questions from every category
  • 5 legendary coaches with deep-cut questions and a 12-second shot clock
  • The GOAT-osaurus waits on the secret island with Mythic rewards
🧢Your player and your dino team
  • Create your own player: name, hair, skin tone and freckles
  • 35 pieces of gear from Common to Mythic, and your helmet, uniform and cleats change your look
  • Recruit the dinos you beat, nickname them, and bring 3 along for special perks
  • Your lead dino follows you around the map
  • 8 dino types with football-pun names, plus rare golden dinos
🎮Ways to play
  • 4 difficulty levels: Rookie, Pro, All-Pro and Superfan
  • Daily Challenge: the same 10 questions for everyone each day, with a score you can share
  • 46 awards to earn, from bronze to platinum
  • Power-ups like 50/50 hints and Timeout cards
  • An original chiptune soundtrack
📱Good to know
  • Free, with no download, sign-up or ads
  • Plays on computers, phones and tablets
  • Saves automatically, and you can move your game to another device with a save code
  • Family-friendly: no violence, just plays, hydration and out-coaching
  • Up to date through Super Bowl LX (February 2026)
